answer_1.quote: We first create SUMMEVAL-OP, a reference-free opinion summarization dataset covering 7 dimensions, for the e-commerce domain... The evaluation covers 7 dimensions fluency, coherence, relevance, faithfulness, aspect coverage, sentiment consistency, and specificity related to the evaluation of opinion summaries.

answer_2.quote: Following baseline metrics are used: ROUGE-{1,2,L} score, BERTSCORE, BARTSCORE, SUMMAC, UNIEVAL. We include G-EVAL as our prompt-based baseline.

answer_3.quote: Our OP-I-PROMPT emerges as a good alternative for evaluating opinion summaries across all 7 dimensions. We investigate two prompt strategies and test the applicability of different prompt approaches on closed-source and open-source LLMs for opinion summary evaluation.

answer_4.quote: We hired 3 Masters' students with experience in opinion summarization as annotators... each summary was annotated by 3 raters for 7 dimensions, amounting to 2,912 summary-level ratings. Annotators received specific guidelines on how to penalize summaries based on fluency levels, coherence, relevance, etc.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators received specific guidelines on how to penalize summaries based on the seven dimensions (fluency, coherence, relevance, faithfulness, aspect coverage, sentiment consistency, specificity).
